contexts.text: Shall send them into a furnace of fire ().
A furnace of fire = the evils of cupidities.
Among the Spirits from Jupiter there are some they call chimney sweepers... SE 874.
Like soot from a chimney on fire.
His feet like fine brass burning in a furnace () = Divine natural good.
Like a chimney sweeper sticking in a dusky chimney.
Such appear there like chimney sweepers.
It is said, as if they burned in a furnace, in order to express the Divine love in the greatest degree, and in its fullness.
By a furnace of fire, or a furnace is meant the Hells. AE 911:5.
